opinions.text: Ct. App. Ariz. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 823.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted, and 10 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted an additional 10 minutes for oral argument.
